shapes.rising_now: score = drift over the recent period (latest month included). Basket = top fifth by score.
shapes.turning_up: score = percentile composite of falling drift over the 189 sessions before the recent period and rising drift over the recent period. Basket = every stock with negative prior drift and positive recent drift.
shapes.long_uptrend: score = 12-1 drift percentile, with stocks whose recent-period drift is positive ranked ahead of all others. Basket = top fifth by 12-1 drift that also has positive recent drift.

note: US index union, monthly rebalancing, next-open entry, equal weight, 0.05% one-way cost on turnover. Excess is against the equal-weight universe of stocks with a next-month return. All 12 combinations were fixed before running and are reported; the earlier turnaround-check-v1 is turning_up at 3m (min_traded rules differ slightly).
